tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List the open-source AI applications hosted and ready to run at AI NetCafé (ainetcafe.com). Each one normally requires local setup (Docker/Python + your own model API key); here they run pre-configured. Use this to find a tool for a task like translating a PDF with formulas intact, generating a Powe

tools.name: get_app
tools.description: Full details of one hosted application: what it does, how to use it, measured benchmark scores, source repository, and the URL a human can open to run it.

tools.name: ask_model
tools.description: Send a prompt to one specific large language model and get the answer plus its exact cost in USD. Useful when you want a second opinion from a different model, or a cheaper model for a bulk subtask.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Run one prompt across multiple LLMs in parallel and return every answer side by side with its real measured cost and latency. This answers "which model should I actually use for this kind of task?" with data instead of guesswork — useful before committing a long job to an expensive model.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List every model callable through AI NetCafé with its input/output price per million tokens, so you can pick by cost as well as capability.

tools.name: deep_research
tools.description: Start an autonomous web research task. The agent plans sub-questions, searches the web, reads the sources and writes a report with citations — this is real research, not a single model call, and takes 2-5 minutes. Returns a job_id immediately; poll check_job to get the report. Use this when you need

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Get the status or result of a job started by deep_research. Poll every 20-30 seconds until status is "done" or "error".

tools.name: translate_pdf
tools.description: Translate a PDF from a URL while preserving the original layout — formulas, figures and two-column academic typesetting stay intact, unlike ordinary translators that flatten the document. Returns a job_id; poll check_job for the download links (translated-only and bilingual side-by-side). Typically

tools.name: make_slides
tools.description: Turn a topic or an outline into a real downloadable .pptx file — not a link into someone's web editor. Returns a job_id; poll check_job for the download URL. Usually 1-3 minutes. Powered by Presenton (open source) hosted at AI NetCafé.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_app, make_slides · Private data: list_apps, list_models, translate_pdf, make_slides · Public sink: ask_model · Destructive: list_apps, get_app, compare_models.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_app, make_slides · Private data: list_apps, list_models, translate_pdf, make_slides · Public sink: ask_model · Destructive: list_apps, get_app, compare_models

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
